evals.expected_output: Runs cyoda-status.sh (connected, development). Asks automated or guided; the developer says automated. Discovers models with cyoda-call.sh GET /model/ (orders v1 LOCKED), reads the workflow export, reads crud --section ENDPOINTS, creates an entity from the manifest's sample, reports the state after create (draft), lists GET /entity/{id}/transitions, fires submit with PATCH {} (merge-patch, If-Match: *), checks the state (submitted; approve held by its criterion at amount 5000), prints the summary table, then offers to delete only the entity it created and to show its audit trail.

assertions.text: Reads or names `crud --section ENDPOINTS` (and/or `models --section ENDPOINTS`) for the calls it makes
